# CONF-018: Cacheable results carry ttlMs and cacheScope

| Severity | Applies to | Spec section |
|---|---|---|
| error | modern era, stdio, http | [2026-07-28/server/utilities/caching#cacheable-results](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/server/utilities/caching#cacheable-results) |

Calls server/discover and, if tools are declared, tools/list. Servers MUST include caching hints on complete results of these operations: ttlMs as an integer >= 0 and cacheScope as public or private.

From the command line: `mcpprobe checks explain CONF-018`. To leave it out of a run, add `"CONF-018"` to `[checks] disable` in [mcpprobe.toml](../configuration.md); to change how much it counts, use `severity_overrides`.
